publications.dateBasis: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate; earliest electronic/print date as indexed
publications.source: Europe PMC MED (PubMed records), core API

Nature: npj Aging and Mechanisms of Disease
NEJM: The New England Journal of Medicine
Lancet: The Lancet Regional Health. Western Pacific
The Lancet Regional Health. Southeast Asia
Other selected major journals: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

publications.journalPolicy: Explicit selected journal list plus Nature/npj-branded titles. Journal family is a scope criterion, not an impact-factor threshold or assessment of individual paper quality. Reviews and corrections are retained and typed. Scientific Reports and Heliyon are excluded. No numeric impact-factor threshold is asserted.
limitations: All search pages fetched; publication indexing can lag or omit work. This is not a guaranteed exhaustive researcher bibliography.

Identity is accepted only with matching author name and author-specific current institution affiliation, or an ORCID established from such a record. Papers predating current institutional affiliation without a linked ORCID remain candidates.
Ambiguous candidates are excluded from verified results. Shared author-name tokens alone never establish identity.
Funding acknowledgements in publication metadata do not establish a researcher as principal investigator.
includedJournals: Annals of oncology : official journal of the European Society for Medical Oncology
Journal of clinical oncology : official journal of the American Society of Clinical Oncology
Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
The New England journal of medicine

federalFunding.fiscalYearsSearched: All fiscal years; project end >= 2021-10-28, then annual budget overlap and cutoff checks
federalFunding.dateRule: Annual budget period overlaps inclusive window; falls back to project period where budget dates absent. Award notices and budget starts after cutoff excluded.
federalFunding.identityRule: Exact normalized first/last name plus expected institution anchors RePORTER PI profile ID; same ID permits earlier institutions. Explicit name variants in reproducible script. Unconfirmed identities excluded.
federalFunding.amountRule: Amounts are fiscal-year award totals, not annual expenditure, personal allocation, or spending within the five-year window. Older fiscal years are retained where a multi-year budget overlaps the window. Subproject dollar amounts suppressed. Do not sum duplicate application IDs across researchers. No total calculated.
federalFunding.coverage: All atlas researchers queried; not an exhaustive accounting of funding. RePORTER contains NIH and participating federal agencies only.

otherFunding.scope: Supplemental primary-source non-NIH funding evidence, 2021-10-28 through 2026-10-28. Includes awards with documented project-period overlap and awards/support announced in the window. Not an exhaustive non-NIH grant census.
limitations: Announcement dates are not legal award dates. When exact award dates or project dates are unavailable they remain null.
Full project amounts, support packages, gifts and program ceilings are distinguished; none represent personal income. Amounts are USD unless noted.
Unknown amounts are null, not zero. Missing awards do not mean no funding. Internal seed grants and private philanthropic gifts are explicitly labeled.
Award records and direct investigator-role announcements establish funding links, not research-topic graph edges. No collaboration links inferred.

roles.publicationRule: Author positions are derived from the ordered indexed author list and the already verified author identity. Middle coauthor is an author-position category, not an assessment of contribution. Last author is not automatically a PI. Corresponding authorship and equal contribution are not systematically verified.
roles.fundingRule: Contact PI and multiple/named PI are recorded RePORTER roles. Co-investigator is retained where explicitly sourced. Other recipient, mentor, project-lead and philanthropic support roles remain separate; subproject scope is labeled.

technologies.scope: 12 selectively reviewed existing atlas labs plus automated title-based discovery across all 101 profiles. Not a complete regional capability census.
technologies.documented: Explicit lab/institutional descriptions, including date-labeled historical research. Does not certify current operational capacity or resource availability.
technologies.publication: Explicit technology terms in titles of identity-matched publications in the existing journal/date window. Includes reviews. Discovery lead only; source authorship role retained.
technologies.samples: Reported research use is distinct from access to specimens. Banks and cores are separately listed with access notes. No patient-level records collected.
technologies.edges: Existing graph edges remain topic overlap. Technology matrix cells link researchers to evidence; they do not create collaborations.
technologies.dateRule: Lab and core sources are not restricted to the publication five-year/journal filter. Historical source dates are displayed when known.

clinicalAccess.coverage: Selective, not a census of access. All researchers retain unknown fields where not reviewed.
clinicalAccess.degreeRule: MD/PhD, MD and equivalent medical credentials are indicators only. PhD-only and unreviewed credentials are not interpreted as no access.
clinicalAccess.clinicalPublicationRule: Indexed Clinical Trial type or title terms patient(s), patient-derived, clinical trial, phase I/II/III/1/2/3, randomized/randomised. Papers retain the existing 2021-10-28 to 2026-10-28 window and author roles; no full-text specimen verification.
clinicalAccess.proximityRule: Institutional medical-campus context only; no distance calculated and no individual clinical appointment inferred.
clinicalAccess.accessRule: No access probability or confirmed-sharing label. Current inventories, collection permissions, recruitment and transfer permissions require project-specific confirmation.
clinicalAccess.edges: Shared-topic edges unchanged; no coauthorship or campus-based collaboration edges.

activity.name: Pareto multidimensional activity comparison v2

dimensions.students: Website-listed student count, uncapped; unknown if roster unreviewed
dimensions.engagement: Distinct documented lab outreach/engagement years, 2022–2026; unknown if no positive evidence
dimensions.breadth: Documented activity-mode count, 1–6; unknown if no mode documented
dimensions.volunteers: Explicitly verified volunteer headcount; all unknown in current edition

activity.rule: A dominates B iff A >= B on every selected dimension and A > B on at least one. Equal vectors do not dominate each other. All axes are maximized; no weights, sums or compensation.
activity.fronts: Layer 1 is the nondominated set among complete records; remove it and repeat for subsequent layers. At least two selected dimensions and two complete records required. A layer is not a quality score.
activity.scope: Computed interactively within the current main filters and activity coverage filter. Default axes are students, engagement and breadth. Default data have only one complete record, so no frontier is assigned. Disable engagement to explore a clearly labeled two-axis comparison.
activity.missing: Never replace missing values with zero. Exclude incomplete records from dominance; show Not assessed and missing dimensions. Frontier is conditional on available evidence and incomplete labs may dominate if assessed.
activity.uncertainty: Observed source-evidence frontier only, not a robust frontier of true activity. Counts may be stale, breadth review is selective, historical outreach differs from current headcount. No inference of mentoring quality, demographic diversity or volunteer participation.
activity.legacy: Previous weighted totals and bounds are retained only under legacyWeightedIndex for reproducibility, not used in the current UI or Pareto logic.

studentWork.scope: Student work descriptions attached to the six reviewed lab rosters. Coverage is selective; no exhaustive student census.
studentWork.fields: Project or question, explicitly described methods, educational role, work-description status, named mentors, source and review date.
studentWork.attribution: Only individual bios support student assignments. Prior-lab experience and lab-wide methods are not assigned as current work. Interests and proposed work retain those labels. No task completion, effort, volunteer status or publication ownership inferred.
studentWork.dates: Source update and project start/end dates generally unstated; review date is not a project date. Stale or conflicting membership signals remain flagged.
studentWork.outputs: No student-to-publication attribution performed; empty output lists mean unreviewed, not no outputs.
studentWork.scorePolicy: Student work descriptions do not change the activity-score formula or roster-based proxy counts. Membership uncertainty remains visible; counts are website-listed rather than verified current headcounts.

legacyActivityIndex.name: Research activity — documented evidence index v1
legacyActivityIndex.formula: Students: 4 × min(website-listed current students,10). Engagement: 10 × min(distinct years with dated lab-attributed outreach/volunteer participation,2), using 2022–2026. Breadth: 40 × documented activity-mode count / 6. Round to one decimal.
legacyActivityIndex.missingData: Missing student count and engagement are null, not zero. Display documented points to maximum possible points for unresolved components. This is a missing-evidence interval, not a statistical confidence interval. No definitive rank. Student component uses the reviewed roster as its proxy value; website incompleteness/staleness remains a limitation.
legacyActivityIndex.breadthRule: Count each mode once, regardless of how many technologies or papers support it. Missing modes are unreviewed, not confirmed absent; upper bound retains all 40 points. Mode sources can overlap with the other components; intentional weighting of training and engagement is explicit.
legacyActivityIndex.volunteerRule: Never infer volunteer status from undergraduate status, research participation, general recruitment, personal extracurriculars, or institutional programs. No volunteer headcount verified in this edition. Dated lab outreach can contribute engagement points but is explicitly not a volunteer count.
legacyActivityIndex.dates: Roster review: 2026-10-30; source update dates unknown. Recent outreach: full years 2022–2026. Publications retain 2021-10-28 to 2026-10-28. Undated outreach is context only.
legacyActivityIndex.scope: Six selectively reviewed rosters; no exhaustive comparison across 101 labs. Default alphabetical view; optional sorting is by documented evidence, not true activity. Existing publication journal and identity limitations apply.
legacyActivityIndex.excluded: Alumni, postdocs/staff from student headcounts; personal hobbies, demographics, assumed collaboration, institution-wide programs from individual scores.
